reply.text: {"route": "care", "say": "Good question to ask before you start. At 16 you can train hard and get stronger, but maxing out is a different thing. Testing true one-rep maxes is something to do carefully, with a coach or parent watching and well-warmed-up, not as a regular habit. Let's build you a solid program that pushes you without leaning on maxes. What days can you train, and does your gym have a spotter or a coach around?"}
